question: After the correctness and security blockers are fixed, should OpenClaw ship default-enabled workspaces and custom-widget execution together, or stage trusted workspaces before custom widgets?
rationale: The change creates durable persisted state and public CLI/tool contracts while permitting operator-approved agent-authored browser code, so the final bundled scope requires explicit product and security ownership.

options.title: Sponsor integrated feature
options.body: Land the combined feature after binding approval to exact data access and completing exact-head lifecycle proof.

options.title: Stage trusted workspaces first
options.body: Land layout and built-in widgets now while deferring custom-widget serving and execution to a later security-reviewed change.

options.title: Keep it external
options.body: Decline default bundling and ask for independent plugin distribution.

recommendation.title: Sponsor integrated feature
recommendation.body: Land the combined feature after binding approval to exact data access and completing exact-head lifecycle proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main ownership of the bundled UI seam and authorship of the integrated branch make this person the strongest available decision owner.
